elements.label: Selection highlight bar (moves to Personal Assistant row)
Shortcut badge (now Cmd 2 on selected row)
Chat window with popover (slow upward drift)

pattern.description: Arrow-key navigation in the preset popover: the selection bar and its Cmd-number badge step from 'Ask Anything' down to 'Personal Assistant' in one frame, while the whole window keeps a slow upward drift.
pattern.why_premium: The focus step is an instant native UI state change (no fake tween), and the shortcut badge travelling with the selection teaches the keyboard shortcut for free; the continuous drift keeps the frame alive between steps.

build_hint.gsap: Drift: gsap.to('.chat-window', {y: '-=20', duration: 2, ease: 'none'}). Step: tl.set('.preset-row', {className: 'preset-row'}).set('.preset-row:nth-child(2)', {className: 'preset-row selected'}) at the beat; the badge is part of the selected-row template so it appears with it (instant).
build_hint.remotion: selectedIndex = frame >= stepFrame ? 1 : 0; render the highlight bar and Cmd badge on rows[selectedIndex] with no interpolation. Window translateY = interpolate(frame, [0, 60], [0, -20], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) (linear).

notes: Energy spike on the first burst frame is the selection step; the later ramp is the slow drift (camera verdict none). b01 is a broad diff box used for the drifting window. Same interaction type as e004 (selection hop) in another UI.
